messages:
ana (Marketing): Quick sync — we need to lock the X + LinkedIn cadence for the benchmark report + webinar next Thu. High level: hero post, 2 reminder posts, webinar sign-up post, and follow-up thread for attendees. Also routing for inbound sign-ups.

joseph (Social): Got it. Do we have final hero image and a 16:9 banner?

sarah (Design): Working on two banner options, will drop PNG + Figma link by EOD.

ana? (typo) ana (Marketing): :eyes: great. Also need 2 short variations for X (tight 1-liner + slightly longer) and one LinkedIn long-form post. Can we do one more upbeat tone and one technical tone?

joseph (Social): I'll draft copies. Posting schedule suggestion:
- Thu 10:00 PT hero post (announce benchmark + webinar)
- Mon 09:00 PT reminder 1 (data highlight)
- Wed 11:00 PT reminder 2 (final reminders / speakers)
- Thu (webinar day) 08:30 PT sign-up roundup + noon live promo
- Fri follow-up thread with clip + CTA to recording

mike (Growth): For paid boost: recommend boosting hero post and Wed reminder. Budget ask: $1k total, target dev/platform audiences.

ana? ana (Marketing): @mike noted. Tim, routing: when people sign up via the webinar form, do they go to SDR queue or marketing ops first? We need <48h follow-up for warm leads.

tim (SDR): Put them in the "Webinar - Hot" SFDC queue. I can take first outreach for US leads. Need UTM + form field to capture company size and use case.

ana? ana (Marketing): Ok route -> SFDC queue: Webinar - Hot. Add hidden field: "lead_source=benchmark_webinar" and UTMs. Joseph, can you add UTM to the registration link? Example:
```
https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_march26
```

joseph (Social): Yep. Also will pin a comment on X with speaker highlights and add a follow-up thread template for replies. Who wants to own live replies?

mike (Growth): I'll own first-hour replies and sentiment triage. Joseph can pick up after.

joseph (Social): Draft copies below — feedback please.

X variant A (short/technical):
"New benchmark: inference cost vs latency across open models. Join our March 26 webinar to see how to cut per-token cost without sacrificing latency — register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"

X variant B (upbeat):
"We ran a huge inference benchmark and the results surprised us. Want faster answers for less? Join our live webinar March 26 — seats limited: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"

LinkedIn (long):
"We just completed a comprehensive inference benchmark comparing latency and cost across popular open models. In our upcoming webinar on March 26 we'll walk through the methodology, key takeaways, and strategies (batching, quantization, routing) you can adopt to lower costs while preserving quality. Speakers: Alex (Runtime), Priya (Applied ML). Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"

What we'd like from reviewers:
- Design: hero banner + 16:9 slide
- Product: one-liner technical blurb (2 sentences) for the social post and speaker titles
- Growth: approve paid boost budget + audience
- SDR: confirm SFDC queue mapping and lead field names

sarah (Design): I'll upload the two banner PNGs to the thread in ~3 hours. Which size do you want for LinkedIn vs X?

ana? ana (Marketing): LinkedIn 1200x627, X hero 1600x900 and a square 1200x1200 for in-feed. Perfect.

joseph (Social): Also proposing engagement play: first 24h — reply to every comment that asks a question with a short answer + link to webinar; use saved replies for standard Qs. After webinar, pin 3 best replies and share recording.

mike (Growth): Agree. Also add a partner tag list for the post to increase reach. I can compile handles.

tim (SDR): For inbound copy, please include a hidden field in the form named "use_case" and "company_size" as discussed. That makes triage faster.

ana? ana (Marketing): Will update Notion with the final schedule and assets links. Notion page: https://notion.redwood.ai/marketing/benchmark-webinar (will paste final link when ready).

sched-bot: Scheduled post: 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC -> X hero draft (pending approval).

joseph (Social): Final asks before I schedule: 1) approve copy variants 2) attach hero image 3) confirm boost budget. If we get approvals here I'll queue posts and tag @mike for boost sign-off.

ana? ana (Marketing): Approving copy variant A for technical channel and B for product channel. Budget approved in principle; @mike finalize audiences and I'll sign off on the budget commit before we spend. :white_check_mark:

sarah (Design): Uploaded banners -> https://files.redwood.ai/drive/bench-banners.zip :sparkles:

joseph (Social): Drafts scheduled once I get a thumbs up on images and budget. I'll also prepare 2 reply templates for common Qs.

mike (Growth): I'll send the audiences + final boost plan by EOD tomorrow.

ana? ana (Marketing): Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: after webinar, person owning follow-ups = @tim for sales outreach, @joseph to amplify highlights on social, and @mike to run paid retargeting.

tim (SDR): Got it. Will prepare an outreach template.

joseph (Social): I'll handle post-webinar follow-ups and recording distribution. Leaving this thread open for approvals.

ana? ana (Marketing): Closing loop — please react with :thumbsup: once you see your action item.

mike (Growth): :thumbsup:

sarah (Design): :thumbsup:

tim (SDR): :thumbsup:

joseph (Social): :thumbsup:
